product.name: TechieMatter Recruitment
product.description: A service that sources and screens tech candidates to match employer needs, reducing the effort of reviewing numerous resumes.

product.name: TechieMatter Assessment
product.description: A customized technical skills evaluation service that tests coding and other technical abilities for various roles and seniority levels.

product.name: TechieMatter Expert Interview
product.description: A service providing expert-led technical interviews to evaluate and verify candidates' skills and suitability for advanced tech roles.

product.name: TechieMatter Onboarding
product.description: A service that manages the legal, financial, compliance, payroll, tax, and insurance aspects of onboarding remote tech employees globally.
